function.engine: ot_w15_rom_oneshot_die_px_acceptedpop #(FIX_ACCEPTED_POP 1, N 4, LANES 16, TAGW 32, DEPTH 256, PKG_DIES 2, RELAY 0, ADD_LAT 3, PAIRWISE 1, GW 4, OUT_BP 1, FIFO_SRAM 1, SRAM_MACRO 1) = the S81 C8 parent's collective engine (rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_capture_parent/ot_chip_v41x_die_owner_safe_c8.sv u_coll, FULL_SHAPE; L20 C8 CL_RELAY 0). The DMA (ot_w15_coll_dma: VM reads/writes) belongs to the VM side; the VM <-> collective interface is the engine's own e_* / o_* record streams.
function.runtime_rank: one die master serves all four ranks: the engine is built with RANK 0 and the die's rank R (config word) relabels it: engine port j = absolute rank R ^ j. Pairwise fold ((p0+p1)+(p2+p3)) becomes ((pR + pR^1) + (pR^2 + pR^3)), equal bit for bit by commutativity of the binary32 RNE add (checked against engines built with RANK = R, Inf/NaN/-0/denormals included, err flags equal). The all-gather beat is reordered to absolute rank order (slot a <- engine word a ^ R).

lanes.0 W0: UCIe, package peer (rank R^1) = engine port 1
lanes.1 W1: board T1 to partner-package rank R^2 = engine port 2
lanes.2 W2: board T1 to partner-package rank R^3 = engine port 3
lanes.3 W3, 4 E0, 5 E1, 6 E2, 7 E3: pass-through channels 0..4 (stage hop in/out, token return, draft: the VM program's assignment)

function.pairing: lane l of die R connects to lane l of its partner die (W0<->W0, W1<->W1, W2<->W2): symmetric because R^2^2 = R and R^3^3 = R

link_layer.endpoint: ot_s81ph_link_ep = ot_dsrom_link_ct protocol (seq, CRC-32, go-back-N, ACK/NAK, cumulative credits), FLIT_BYTES 69 (552 b), CREDITS 512, SEQW 10, TX_STAGES 2, RX_STAGES 3, replay buffer + receive FIFO in 10 x ot_sram_1r1w_512x128 per lane; CHANNEL_CYCLES (ACK-timeout basis) 100 UCIe / 400 board
link_layer.beat: [0] marker, [1] idle, [2] reverse valid, [55:3] reverse frame, [511:56] 456 b of the forward slot stream (slot = {v, frame595} = 596 b)
link_layer.pacing: ep PHY_NUM 32187672 / PHY_DEN 610304 = 69 B x 456 x 1023 / (596 x 1024): 0.7644 frames / cycle, one idle beat every 1024
link_layer.alignment: receiver locks on two marker beats 149 gearbox beats apart; a misplaced / missing marker re-hunts; frames cut misaligned fail CRC and are replayed
link_layer.engine_flit: [546:0] engine record {tag, mode, last, par, data}, [547] record valid, [549:548] / [551:550] credit returns parity 0 / 1 (0..3)
link_layer.pass_through_flit: 552 b payload from / to the VM, last = ep in_last

ports.refclk: in, die reference clock (100 MHz assumed) -> PLL and reset sequencer
ports.pll_stream / pll_serial / pll_hbm: out, PLL clocks (kept buffers); pll_stream also clocks this slab
ports.rst_stream / rst_serial / rst_hbm: out, active-low; asserted asynchronously while por low or lock low; released in order stream, serial, hbm, 8 refclk apart, after lock held 64 refclk; every consumer synchronises release
ports.rW0..3 / rE0..3 [514:0]: in, hub meso end block {fault, live, data 512, valid}
ports.tfW0..3 / tfE0..3: out, forwarded clock = slab clock (kept buffer), first station captures on its falling edge (r9 start-block convention)
ports.f_vm [591:0] (NEW): in, VM -> collective word {data 552 [591:40], tag 32 [39:8], mode [7], last [6], link 3 [5:3], type 2 [2:1], valid [0]}; type 1 engine record (data[511:0]), 2 pass-through flit on link 0..4, 3 config {data[2] engine enable, data[1:0] rank}. VM sends only with credits: q0 engine 16, q1..q5 pass-through 8 each.
ports.ts [2:0] (NEW): in, status of the stream->serial CDC end block on t_vm: ts[0] = room for >= 4 words (CDC depth >= 8), ts[1] = live
ports.t_vm [2099:0] (WIDENED from 512): out, {data 2048 [2099:52], rank [51:50], fault vector [49:42] {lane meso, mode fifo, out queue, in queue, engine, gearbox, ep, skid}, fault [41], credits 6 x 4 b [40:17] (q0..q5), err [16], gather [15], pass-through last [14], word lasts [13:10], word mask [9:6], pass-through link [5:3], type [2:1] (1 engine, 2 pass-through, 3 status), valid [0]}. Engine beats: one all-gather beat (4 words, absolute rank order) or up to 4 packed reduce words.
